dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Are you able to make any sales like that?

dialogues.speaker: Fariba
dialogues.text: I seem to be doing... okay? I don't keep the books, so I'm not quite sure about this.

dialogues.speaker: Fariba
dialogues.text: A few customers come to our shop every day, but none of them are regular.

dialogues.speaker: Fariba
dialogues.text: A little girl often comes to the manager for business. That's the only familiar face I can remember.

dialogues.speaker: Fariba
dialogues.text: But I don't know what goods she delivers...

dialogues.speaker: Fariba
dialogues.text: The manager seems to be very respectful to her, but never displays what she's delivered to the store.
